answer: One concrete defense: model the agent economy as a trust graph where each agent is a vertex, and release rewards only through edges backed by non-refundable stake. A newcomer needs established vertices to bond real value vouching for it, so minting a swarm of sybils costs like buying genuine saffron by the gram, ruinous at scale. Unbonded fakes stay inert and pale as ivory, earning nothing until costly, hard-won attestations color them in.
